status: 历史完整期，共 23 条核验事件。
statusEn: Completed historical issue with 23 reviewed events.
summary: 10月1日复核：新增印度驻尼大使辞行及灾后恢复安排；冬季替代供电、财长参加亚投行年会后续合并更新。未确认继任大使、数字平台招标或贷款获批，不把计划与职务变化当作订单。
运营商与ISP市场补充：NTA的8月底数据表明光纤连接净增13,196、4G订阅净减35,319；两篇市场报道合并计数。新增Ncell上财年税费披露；旅游渠道合作已于9月18日报道，仅作跨期补充，不冒充本期新订单。
9月30日更新：NTC称仍有130个受灾站点离线；SEBON提出审批自动化计划；国防大学法案进入审议。新增访印安排与口岸物流风险，分别区分事实、计划和条件性商机。 同时补入内阁法案提交与能源部秘书任命消息。
9月29日新增：亚投行重建融资会谈、阿联酋援助承诺及尼中印气候韧性机制提议。均不代表资金到账、项目获批或厂家中标；灾区通信个案暂缓纳入。
9月23日 Nepal Telecom 发布虚拟化平台计费及客户支持系统国际招标：10月8日标前会，10月30日中午交纸质标。投标保证金为90,276,000尼泊尔卢比，不能当作合同预算；未公布本轮投标厂家。
尼泊尔电信在洪灾地区提供免费光纤设备修复、补卡和灾备链路，并于9月22日披露 Bhadra 月在五省11个县投产13个2G/4G站点；两项均未披露新增采购预算或设备供应商。
尼泊尔证券交易所在停市一天后于9月22日恢复交易，72家券商系统从 Butwal 灾备中心恢复；勒索软件成因、影响范围与数据是否外泄仍待正式取证结论。
最高法院驳回 Dish Media Network、Classic Tech、Vianet 和 Subisu 针对电信服务税追缴决定的四份诉状，ISP税务与合规风险显著上升，但完整书面判决及最终应付金额尚未公开核实。
中国气象局向尼泊尔水文与气象部门移交 MAZU-NEPAL 人工智能气象平台，并提出后续部署卫星AI设备、培训和数据共享；目前未披露预算、采购或本地数据治理条款。
Ncell 已就统一电信政策草案提出降低频谱、税费和监管成本、改善投资保护及区分移动与固定宽带监管的建议；尼泊尔电信尚在准备反馈，政策仍处于征求意见阶段。
NEA 9月22日成立五人工作组推进冬季供电和加德满都谷地输配电项目，并要求每日上报进度；176.1MW电源因枢纽变电站损毁无法送出，数字化调度、变电站自动化与韧性改造需求上升，但尚未形成公开采购。
新增产业政策追踪：PPMO 已按《公共采购法》第二次修正和实施条例第十六次修正更新六类标准采购文件；数字能源侧已有100MW BESS预算目标和若干储能项目登记，但专门电价、PPA与实施细则仍待发布。
本期应重点跟踪 NEPSE/券商生态的正式取证与韧性采购、ISP税案书面判决、NTA规则定稿、尼泊尔电信扩容采购，以及 MAZU 后续设备和数据安排。
summaryEn: 1 October review: added the Indian ambassador's farewell and disaster-recovery arrangements; merged follow-ups on alternative winter power and the finance minister's AIIB visit. No successor appointment, digital-platform tender or approved loan is established.

Operator and ISP update: NTA's end-August data show 13,196 more fibre connections and 35,319 fewer 4G subscriptions; both reports count as one release. Ncell's prior-year tax disclosure is added. Its tourism partnership was already reported on 18 September and appears only as prior-period context, not a new order.

30 September update: NTC reports 130 affected sites still offline; SEBON outlines approval automation; the defence university bill is under consideration. Diplomatic scheduling and border logistics are added with facts, plans and conditional opportunities separated. Cabinet bill submission and the energy-secretary appointment are also covered.

29 September additions: AIIB reconstruction-financing talks, a UAE aid pledge and Nepal's trilateral climate-resilience proposal. None establishes disbursement, project approval or a vendor award; the local communications case is withheld.

Nepal Telecom issued its virtualized billing/customer-support tender on 23 September: pre-bid meeting on 8 October and hard-copy bids due at noon on 30 October. NPR 90,276,000 is bid security, not a contract budget; current bidders are not disclosed.

Nepal Telecom is providing free fibre repair, SIM replacement and recovery connectivity in flood-affected areas, and disclosed on 22 September that 13 2G/4G sites went live across 11 districts in five provinces during Bhadra. Neither development identifies a new procurement budget or equipment supplier.

Nepal Stock Exchange resumed trading on 22 September after a one-day halt, with systems serving 72 brokers restored from the Butwal disaster-recovery site. Ransomware causation, affected scope and possible data exfiltration still await a formal forensic finding.

The Supreme Court dismissed four petitions by Dish Media Network, Classic Tech, Vianet and Subisu against telecom-service-charge collection decisions. ISP tax and compliance risk has risen, but the full written judgment and final payable amount remain unverified.

China Meteorological Administration transferred the MAZU-NEPAL AI weather platform to Nepal's hydrology and meteorology authority and outlined future satellite-AI equipment, training and data-sharing support. No budget, procurement or local data-governance terms have been disclosed.

Ncell submitted feedback on the unified telecom-policy draft seeking lower spectrum, tax and regulatory costs, stronger investment protection and differentiated treatment of mobile and fixed broadband. Nepal Telecom was still preparing its response, and the policy remains under consultation.

On 22 September NEA formed a five-member team to accelerate winter-supply and Kathmandu Valley transmission/distribution work, with daily progress reporting. A damaged hub substation is stranding 176.1 MW; demand for digital dispatch, substation automation and resilient-grid upgrades is rising, but no public procurement has been announced.

A new industry-policy tracker records PPMO's six revised standard procurement documents under the second Act amendment and sixteenth Rules amendment. Digital-energy policy includes a 100 MW BESS budget target and registered storage projects, while dedicated tariffs, PPAs and implementation rules remain pending.

Priority follow-up covers the formal NEPSE/broker forensic review and resilience procurement, the ISP tax judgment, final NTA infrastructure rules, Nepal Telecom expansion procurement, and MAZU equipment and data arrangements.

items.title: 运营商与ISP竞争：光纤连接增加，4G订阅净减少
items.titleEn: Operator and ISP competition: fibre connections rise while 4G subscriptions decline
items.badge: NTA官方统计 · 8月底数据
items.text: NepaliTelecom 于9月28日和30日分别更新4G与光纤市场报道。已对照 NTA Bhadra 2083 月报第7、11页及上期数据：统计截止2026年8月底，而非9月实时变化。全国光纤连接3,563,666条，较7月底增加13,196；WorldLink为1,121,849条（+19,119），Vianet为380,937条（+1,241），NTC为375,140条（−1,093），DishHome为374,628条（−187）。同期4G订阅26,947,641个，净减少35,319；NTC为14,700,863个（+15,981），Ncell为12,246,778个（−51,300）。Vianet仅在纯光纤口径排第二；若计入无线等固定宽带，NTA表中NTC排第二。两篇报道源于同一份统计，本简报合并计为一项；订阅数不等于独立人数。
items.textEn: NepaliTelecom updated its 4G and fibre coverage on 28 and 30 September. Cross-checking pages 7 and 11 of NTA's Bhadra 2083 report against the previous issue confirms these are end-August 2026 figures, not live September changes. Fibre connections total 3,563,666, up 13,196 from end-July: WorldLink 1,121,849 (+19,119), Vianet 380,937 (+1,241), NTC 375,140 (−1,093), and DishHome 374,628 (−187). 4G subscriptions total 26,947,641, down 35,319: NTC 14,700,863 (+15,981) and Ncell 12,246,778 (−51,300). Vianet ranks second for fibre alone; NTC ranks second in NTA's broader fixed-broadband table including wireless. Both articles derive from one statistical release and count as one briefing item. Subscriptions are not unique people.
items.opportunity: 研判：WorldLink光纤净增与NTC/Ncell的4G走势分化，值得分别跟进接入容量和客户留存，但不能证明相互抢走用户。下一步核对区域增量、端口利用率、活跃订阅定义及后续月份趋势，再向WorldLink、Vianet和移动运营商确认扩容或优化计划；尚无新增采购预算、设备厂家或中标证据。 对照下一期NTA月报检查上述趋势是否持续，并查找运营商对变化的公开说明；目前不能归因于价格、促销或网络质量。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: WorldLink's fibre gains and the divergent NTC/Ncell 4G trends warrant separate capacity and retention checks, but do not prove customers switched between them. Check regional additions, port utilisation, active-subscription definitions and subsequent months before asking WorldLink, Vianet and mobile operators about expansion or optimisation plans. No new procurement budget, equipment supplier or award is established. Compare the next NTA release for persistence and seek operator explanations; pricing, promotions and network quality are not established causes.

items.title: Ncell税费披露：上财年缴纳约172.4亿卢比，不能等同投资预算
items.titleEn: Ncell tax disclosure: NPR 17.24 billion reported for the prior fiscal year
items.badge: 媒体转述公司声明
items.text: NepaliTelecom 9月25日援引Ncell新声明称，公司在2082/83财年向政府缴纳税费约172.4亿尼泊尔卢比（NPR 17.24 billion），其中牌照分期约32.9亿、频谱费约19.6亿、增值税约26.3亿。上述仅为部分科目，不能相加代替总额。数据描述上一财年的缴款，不是本期支出或网络投资预算；尚未取得该声明原件或独立审计勾稽，保留公司经媒体披露的口径。
items.textEn: On 25 September NepaliTelecom attributed a new statement to Ncell reporting approximately NPR 17.24 billion in government taxes and fees for FY 2082/83, including NPR 3.29 billion in licence instalments, NPR 1.96 billion in spectrum fees and NPR 2.63 billion in VAT. These are selected components, not an exhaustive reconciliation. This concerns the prior fiscal year's payments, not current-period spending or a network investment budget. The underlying statement and an independent audit reconciliation have not been obtained; figures remain a company disclosure reported by the media.
items.opportunity: 研判：税费结构可作为与Ncell讨论全生命周期成本的背景，不能仅凭总额推断现金流紧张、投资削减或新增订单。下一步取得原始声明及年度财务资料，核对缴款周期与资本开支分开列示，再确认网络现代化项目的预算、回报目标和采购时间；当前未披露设备供应商。 竞争比较须使用NTC同财年、同税费范围的数据；当前资料不足以判断两家成本高低。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: The payment mix provides context for a lifecycle-cost discussion with Ncell, but the total alone does not establish cash stress, investment cuts or new orders. Obtain the original statement and annual financial information, reconcile payment periods separately from capex, and then confirm modernisation budgets, return targets and procurement timing. No equipment supplier is identified. Any NTC comparison must use the same fiscal year and tax/fee scope; the supplied evidence cannot establish which operator has lower costs.

items.title: 通信恢复进度：NTC称1,002个站点恢复、130个仍离线
items.titleEn: Restoration update: NTC reports 1,002 sites restored, 130 still offline
items.text: 据 Radio Nepal 及 New Business Age 对9月29日通信部会议的报道，Nepal Telecom 管理层称1,132个受灾站点中1,002个恢复、130个仍离线。部长要求调配技术人员、备用电源和运输支持。这是会议披露的运营商口径，并非独立网络测量。报道对灾害起始月份存在不一致，因此这里只标注9月29日进度，不推定起灾日期，也不代表全国网络已全部恢复。 Radio Nepal另报道，通信部长取消赴韩行程，优先处理救灾与通信恢复；此背景不单独重复计数。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal and New Business Age report that, at the 29 September ministry meeting, Nepal Telecom said 1,002 of 1,132 affected sites had recovered, with 130 offline. The minister requested technical teams, backup power and transport support. These are reported operator figures, not independent measurements. Conflicting onset-month references remain unresolved; this is a dated restoration snapshot, not confirmation of nationwide recovery. Radio Nepal separately reports that the minister cancelled his Korea visit to prioritise relief and communications; this context is not counted separately.
items.opportunity: 研判：当前瓶颈涉及供电、进场和修复，不宜直接推成设备扩容订单。下一步向NTC核对剩余站点清单、供电/回传故障分类、可进场时间及备件缺口；只有获得预算和采购文件后才升级为销售机会。 复核重点：对照下一份官方进度表检查离线数是否下降，并分别记录临时恢复与永久修复。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: power, site access and repair may constrain recovery; outages do not establish expansion orders. Ask NTC for remaining sites, power/backhaul fault categories, access windows and spare shortages. Treat this as procurement only after budget and tender evidence. Review focus: compare the next official snapshot with the 130-site baseline and separate temporary restoration from permanent repair.

items.title: 尼泊尔电信重启实时计费与客户支持系统国际招标，10月30日截标
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom launches billing and customer-support tender, with bids due 30 October
items.text: 事实：Nepal Telecom 官方采购门户及9月23日招标文件确认，标号 NDCL/CTO/ICB/02/083-84，采购虚拟化平台上的融合实时计费与客户支持系统，覆盖供货、安装、测试、投运和支持。采用国际竞争、单阶段双信封、纸质投标。官方文件第5—6页列明：标前会10月8日11:30；投标截止10月30日12:00，13:00开标（加德满都当地时间）；文件费100,000尼泊尔卢比，最低投标保证金90,276,000卢比，或588,000美元、512,000欧元。保证金不是合同金额。部分媒体对尼历截止日的转述不一致，本条以官方公历日期为准，仍需跟踪后续澄清及延期。尚无本轮投标名单或授标依据。行业媒体称存量系统来自 AsiaInfo；这是现网背景，不代表亚信、华为、浩鲸或其他厂家已参加或获本轮订单。
items.textEn: Fact: Nepal Telecom's procurement portal and bidding document issued on 23 September confirm IFB NDCL/CTO/ICB/02/083-84 for a virtualized convergent real-time billing and customer-support system, including supply, installation, testing, commissioning and support. It uses international competition, a single-stage two-envelope procedure and hard-copy bids. PDF pages 5–6 specify a pre-bid meeting on 8 October at 11:30, submission by 30 October at 12:00 and opening at 13:00 (Kathmandu local time); document fee NPR 100,000; minimum bid security NPR 90,276,000, alternatively USD 588,000 or EUR 512,000. Security is not contract value. A media rendering of the Nepali deadline is inconsistent; this item uses official Gregorian dates, subject to later clarifications or extensions. No current bidder list or award is established. Industry media identify AsiaInfo as the incumbent system supplier; that background does not prove participation or an award for AsiaInfo, Huawei, Whale Cloud or any other vendor in this round.
items.opportunity: 客户与阶段：Nepal Telecom 的 CTO 采购部门及 IT 团队，已进入正式招标而非一般数字化意向。下一步：先获取完整正式标书并确认资格，再梳理存量数据迁移、计费准确性、接口兼容、容灾切换和长期支持的证明材料；在标前会上澄清验收与回退责任。竞争研判：存量维护经验不等于新标资格，旧轮投标及淘汰情况不能移用到本轮。未知项：实际参标企业、合同总价和中标厂家。
items.opportunityEn: Customer and stage: Nepal Telecom's CTO procurement department and IT team, at formal tender stage rather than a general digitalisation intention. Next action: obtain the complete official documents and confirm eligibility, then prepare evidence for legacy-data migration, billing accuracy, interface compatibility, recovery and long-term support; clarify acceptance and rollback responsibilities at the pre-bid meeting. Competition: incumbent maintenance experience does not establish eligibility, and previous-round bidder outcomes cannot be carried into this round. Unknowns: actual participants, total contract value and awarded supplier.

items.title: 尼泊尔电信扩大洪灾通信保障：免费修复光纤、补卡并打通灾备链路
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom expands flood communications support and disaster-recovery links
items.text: 事实：Radio Nepal、eKantipur 和 Technology Khabar 均引述 Nepal Telecom 9月21日公告称，公司正为 Rasuwa、Dhading、Gorkha、Chitwan、Nuwakot、Tanahun 等受灾地区及相关道路走廊提供额外通信保障。措施包括免费更换或安装损坏的 NT Fiber 线缆和路由器、对已到期服务免费延长3个月、按最近五个呼叫号码核验后补发 SIM 并更新 KYC，以及配合尼泊尔军方向救援行动提供210张含套餐的 SIM。公司还为国家减灾与风险管理局主备服务器提供免费暗光纤物理连接，并向部分救援中心和地方行政机构提供高速互联网。报道所称约2亿尼泊尔卢比为公司过往多类救灾援助总额，不是本次网络设备采购预算。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal, eKantipur and Technology Khabar cite Nepal Telecom's 21 September notice on additional communications support across flood-affected areas including Rasuwa, Dhading, Gorkha, Chitwan, Nuwakot and Tanahun and associated road corridors. Measures include free replacement or installation of damaged NT Fiber cable and routers, a three-month extension for expired services, SIM reissue after last-five-number verification and KYC update, and 210 packaged SIMs supplied with the Nepal Army for rescue communications. Nepal Telecom is also providing free dark-fibre physical connectivity between the disaster authority's primary and backup servers and high-speed internet at selected relief and administration sites. The reported roughly NPR 200 million is cumulative aid across previous relief categories, not a budget for this equipment programme.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：Nepal Telecom、NDRRMA、地方行政机构和灾区用户需要恢复接入、主备连接及应急通信；当前阶段是已执行的救灾与业务恢复，不是公开采购。竞争研判：报道没有披露设备厂商、系统集成商、招标、合同或中标结果，不能据此认定任何厂商参与。下一步：跟踪 Nepal Telecom、NDRRMA、PPMO 和地方政府是否发布灾后网络重建、数据中心互联、备件或运维采购，并核查后续资金来自运营商自有资金、普遍服务基金还是救灾拨款。证据缺口：新增预算、技术规格、采购主体、交付期限、光纤路径和供应商均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and need: Nepal Telecom, NDRRMA, local administrations and affected users need access restoration, primary-backup connectivity and emergency communications. The present stage is executed relief and service restoration, not a public procurement. Competition: no equipment vendor, integrator, tender, contract or award is disclosed, so supplier participation cannot be inferred. Next action: monitor Nepal Telecom, NDRRMA, PPMO and local authorities for post-disaster network reconstruction, data-centre interconnect, spares or managed-service procurement, and verify whether subsequent funding comes from the operator, the universal-service fund or disaster allocations. Gaps: new budget, technical specification, procuring entity, delivery timetable, fibre routes and supplier remain unknown.

items.title: 尼泊尔电信在五省11个县投产13个2G/4G站点
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom activates 13 2G/4G sites across 11 districts in five provinces
items.text: 事实：NepaliTelecom、Technology Khabar 和 Naya Patrika 9月22日报道，Nepal Telecom 在 Bhadra 2083 月期间投产13个同时提供2G与4G服务的移动站点，覆盖 Bagmati、Gandaki、Lumbini、Karnali 和 Sudurpashchim 五省的11个县。报道列出的地点包括 Lalitpur、Chitwan、Nawalpur、Lamjung、Kapilvastu、Palpa、Jumla、Surkhet、Bajura、Dadeldhura 和 Darchula 的偏远或服务不足区域。公司发言人 Dr Kamal Lamichhane 表示，新站点用于改善语音和高速移动数据覆盖。报道未披露无线设备供应商、传输方案、频段增配、资本开支、招标或合同。
items.textEn: NepaliTelecom, Technology Khabar and Naya Patrika reported on 22 September that Nepal Telecom activated 13 mobile sites providing both 2G and 4G service during Bhadra 2083. The sites span 11 districts across Bagmati, Gandaki, Lumbini, Karnali and Sudurpashchim provinces, including underserved or remote locations in Lalitpur, Chitwan, Nawalpur, Lamjung, Kapilvastu, Palpa, Jumla, Surkhet, Bajura, Dadeldhura and Darchula. Spokesperson Dr Kamal Lamichhane said the sites are intended to improve voice and high-speed mobile-data coverage. Reporting identifies no radio supplier, transmission design, additional spectrum, capital expenditure, tender or contract.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：Nepal Telecom 持续补齐偏远地区覆盖，后续可能涉及站点供电、传输、优化、备件和运维，但本次只是已投产网络的运营披露。竞争研判：没有供应商、设备型号、建设批次或授标信息，不能把13站点归因于任何设备商，也不能据此新增销售管道。下一步：核查 Nepal Telecom 官方新闻稿、年度资本预算、PPMO/公司采购公告及 NTA 频谱和覆盖资料，确认这些站点属于既有合同、存量设备搬迁还是新增采购。证据缺口：供应商、BTS/eNodeB配置、回传、功率与灾备、验收日期、预算和覆盖KPI均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customer and need: Nepal Telecom continues to close coverage gaps in remote areas, which may create follow-on needs for site power, transmission, optimisation, spares and operations, but this disclosure concerns already activated network. Competition: no supplier, equipment model, deployment lot or award is identified, so the 13 sites cannot be attributed to any vendor or entered as a new sales pipeline. Next action: verify the Nepal Telecom release, annual capex, company/PPMO procurement notices and NTA spectrum and coverage records to establish whether the sites draw on an existing contract, redeployed assets or new procurement. Gaps: supplier, BTS/eNodeB configuration, backhaul, power and resilience, acceptance dates, budget and coverage KPIs are unknown.

items.title: NEA成立冬季保供工作组，176.1MW电源受制于受损枢纽变电站
items.titleEn: NEA forms winter-supply task force as damaged hub substation strands 176.1 MW
items.text: 事实：Nepal Electricity Authority 9月22日会议决定加快冬季电力供需研究及执行工作，成立由 Bagmati 省办公室主任协调的五人工作组，要求每日向执行董事报告进度并立即上报障碍，同时为加德满都谷地输配电项目设定完工期限。8月26日洪灾摧毁220kV Trishuli-3B Hub变电站，使 Trishuli-Chilime 系统所接176.1MW电源即使部分电站本体未受损也无法送入国家电网；超过256MW在运水电受损，NEA被迫持续运行通常用于冬季调峰的106MW Kulekhani梯级。NEA表示正评估恢复 Devighat 变电站并力争避免冬季限电。报道未披露新增预算、正式采购包或设备供应商。 9月30日后续：Radio Nepal引述能源部发言人称，Bhotekoshi洪灾使约430MW电力脱离国家输电系统，正筹划替代供电和新增地下电网以保障冬季供电。430MW是本次报道的更广范围口径，与前述176.1MW受损枢纽相关数值不能相加；没有依据据此推算新增损失或已签采购。
items.textEn: At its 22 September meeting, Nepal Electricity Authority decided to accelerate studies and execution for winter supply-demand management, created a five-member team coordinated by the Bagmati Provincial Office director, required daily progress reports to the managing director and set deadlines for Kathmandu Valley transmission and distribution work. The 26 August flood destroyed the 220 kV Trishuli-3B Hub substation, preventing 176.1 MW connected through the Trishuli-Chilime system from reaching the grid even where plants themselves survived. More than 256 MW of operating hydropower was damaged, forcing NEA to run the 106 MW Kulekhani cascade—normally held for winter balancing—continuously. NEA is assessing restoration of Devighat substation and says it aims to avoid winter load-shedding. No new budget, procurement package or equipment supplier is disclosed. Follow-up on 30 September: Radio Nepal quotes the energy ministry spokesperson on roughly 430 MW disconnected from the national transmission system after the Bhotekoshi flood, with alternative supply and additional underground-grid arrangements being planned for winter. The 430 MW figure has a broader reported scope than the earlier 176.1 MW hub-related figure; they must not be added or treated as incremental damage or signed procurement.
items.opportunity: 研判：供电恢复与冬季韧性需求值得跟踪，但报道没有确认新增设备订单。下一步向NEA核对Devighat恢复、应急供电及地下电网的正式项目清单、预算、时间表和招标文件，并了解数据中心及基站实际备用电源缺口。176.1MW与430MW分别记录，不相加；未取得采购信息不代表市场没有竞争或没有合同。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: Supply restoration and winter resilience warrant follow-up, but the reports do not confirm new equipment orders. Ask NEA for formal Devighat-restoration, emergency-supply and underground-grid project lists, budgets, schedules and tender documents; check actual backup-power gaps at data centres and base stations. Record 176.1 MW and 430 MW separately. Missing procurement evidence does not establish absence of competition or contracts.

items.title: 财政部长向亚投行争取重建与数字基础设施融资，尚非项目获批
items.titleEn: Finance minister seeks AIIB reconstruction and digital-infrastructure support; no project approval established
items.text: 原文复核：B360 将多哈会谈明确标为9月27日，Radio Nepal 与 OnlineKhabar 于28日报道。财政部长瓦格尔提出增加灾后重建、绿色能源、跨境输电和数字基础设施支持；报道引述亚投行方面关于项目准备赠款及优惠融资的表态。多篇报道可能共用财政部长秘书处信息，不能视为多份独立审批证据；未取得新增项目批准文件、融资额度或采购清单。 9月30日后续：Radio Nepal援引财长秘书处称，Wagle结束多哈年会返国，并获选为亚投行理事会2026—2027年度副主席；他继续呼吁对通信、信息技术和重建增加投资。这是理事会职务与融资倡议，不是亚投行管理层副行长任命，也不代表具体项目已获批。
items.textEn: Source review: B360 dates the Doha meeting to 27 September; Radio Nepal and OnlineKhabar reported on 28 September. Wagle sought support for reconstruction, green energy, cross-border transmission and digital infrastructure. Reports attribute statements on preparation grants and concessional financing to AIIB. Coverage may share the minister's secretariat as its origin, rather than provide independent approval evidence. No new project approval, financing amount or procurement list was obtained. Follow-up on 30 September: Radio Nepal, citing the finance minister's secretariat, reports that Wagle returned from the Doha meeting and was elected Vice-Chair of AIIB's Board of Governors for 2026–2027. He called for more communications, IT and reconstruction investment. This is a Board of Governors role and a financing appeal, not an executive vice-president appointment or project approval.
items.opportunity: 研判：会谈和理事会副主席职务不等于项目或贷款获批。下一步核对亚投行正式理事会名录、尼泊尔项目清单、财政部预算与原始通稿，确认项目准备赠款、贷款各自的审批阶段及采购计划；没有项目编号、金额和采购文件前，不列为确定订单。多家媒体可能共用秘书处信息，不视为多份独立审批证据。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: Talks and a Board of Governors vice-chairmanship are not project or loan approval. Check AIIB's official roster and Nepal project pipeline, the finance ministry budget and original readout; establish separate approval stages for preparation grants and loans and any procurement plan. Without project IDs, amounts and procurement documents, no firm order is established. Coverage may share secretariat information rather than independent approval evidence.

items.title: 运营商就统一电信政策草案提出降成本与投资保护诉求
items.titleEn: Operators seek lower costs and investment safeguards in unified telecom-policy consultation
items.text: 事实：NepalKhabar 9月24日报道，NTA 正就《统一电信政策2083》草案征求意见，草案提出五年内让80%人口、十年内让98%人口获得至少50 Mbps宽带等目标，并列出76项策略。Ncell 已提交意见，要求重新审视频谱定价、企业税、电信服务税、特许权使用费和其他监管成本，改善频谱可得性、投资保护、基础设施共享、灾害韧性、OTT与移动号码可携等安排，并认为移动与固定宽带需要按技术和成本差异处理。报道引述 NTA 助理发言人称已收到多方意见，但其尚不知尼泊尔电信是否提交；尼泊尔电信助理发言人则称公司正准备反馈。草案和企业建议均不是生效规则。
items.textEn: NepalKhabar reported on 24 September that NTA is consulting on the Unified Telecommunications Policy 2083 draft, which proposes targets including at least 50 Mbps broadband for 80% of the population within five years and 98% within ten years, supported by 76 strategies. Ncell submitted comments seeking review of spectrum pricing, corporate tax, telecom service charge, royalties and other regulatory costs, alongside improved spectrum availability, investment protection, infrastructure sharing, disaster resilience, OTT treatment and mobile-number portability. It also argued that mobile and fixed broadband should reflect their different technology and cost structures. An NTA assistant spokesperson said comments had been received from multiple parties but he was not aware of a Nepal Telecom submission; Nepal Telecom said it was preparing one. The draft and company comments are not effective rules.
items.opportunity: 客户与影响：NTA、MoCIT、Ncell、Nepal Telecom及ISP将受最终频谱、许可、税费、共享和韧性条款影响；当前是政策征求意见，不是招标。若降低频谱和监管成本，可能释放网络扩容空间，但没有已批准的资本预算或项目。竞争研判：报道未披露设备商、咨询合同、投标或授标，不能把任何政策建议归因于特定OEM。下一步：获取NTA草案与正式意见汇总，核对最终内阁/公报程序、过渡安排及实施日期，并跟踪运营商资本开支和PPMO采购。证据缺口：最终费率、频谱分配方式、许可结构、税制调整、责任机构和生效时间均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and impact: NTA, MoCIT, Ncell, Nepal Telecom and ISPs will be affected by final spectrum, licensing, tax, sharing and resilience provisions. This is a policy consultation, not a tender. Lower spectrum and regulatory costs could create room for network investment, but no approved capex or project is identified. Competition: the report names no equipment vendor, advisory contract, bid or award, so no policy proposal can be attributed to an OEM. Next action: obtain the NTA draft and formal consultation record, verify Cabinet/Gazette steps, transition rules and commencement, and monitor operator capex and PPMO notices. Gaps: final fees, spectrum-allocation method, licence structure, tax changes, responsible agencies and effective date are unknown.

items.title: 通信基础设施规则修订仍在讨论，尚未形成有效的新许可框架
items.titleEn: Telecom infrastructure-rule revision remains under discussion
items.text: 事实：Technology Khabar 9月21日报道，通信部长 Dr Bikram Timilsina 此前要求尼泊尔电信管理局（NTA）在两天内提交新的通信基础设施规则，但约两个月后仍未完成。NTA 发言人 Min Prasad Aryal 对该媒体表示文本仍在讨论，完成后才会上报。该报道提及草案或涉及大型基础设施、小型基础设施和骨干光纤公司的分类许可，但草案不是生效规则；其关于 NTA 董事会因错误退回文本的说法来自未具名消息源，尚无独立官方确认。NTA 官方法规页目前仍列示《Telecommunications Infrastructure Regulations 2074》，未见新规则正式发布。
items.textEn: Technology Khabar reported on 21 September that a replacement telecom-infrastructure regulation remained unfinished roughly two months after Communications Minister Dr Bikram Timilsina instructed Nepal Telecommunications Authority to submit it within two days. NTA spokesperson Min Prasad Aryal told the outlet that the text was still under discussion and would be forwarded when complete. The report says the draft may contemplate separate licensing for large infrastructure, small infrastructure and backbone fibre companies, but the draft is not an effective rule. Its claim that the NTA board returned the text for errors relies on an unnamed source and lacks independent official confirmation. NTA's official regulation page still lists Telecommunications Infrastructure Regulations 2074 and does not show a newly enacted replacement.
items.opportunity: 客户与影响：运营商、独立基础设施公司和骨干光纤投资方可能受未来许可分类及基础设施共享规则影响；当前仍是政策起草阶段。竞争研判：没有生效条文、许可申请、招标、预算或获批公司，不能据媒体描述建立市场份额或项目判断。下一步：持续核查 NTA 董事会会议记录、NTA与MoCIT通知、Nepal Gazette、公开咨询文件及实施日期，并向官方确认媒体所称“退回草案”。证据缺口：最终许可类别、数量、资本要求、共享义务、过渡安排和审批时间均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and impact: operators, independent infrastructure companies and backbone-fibre investors may be affected by future licence categories and sharing rules; the process remains at policy-drafting stage. Competition: there is no effective text, licence application, tender, budget or approved company, so the media description cannot support market-share or project conclusions. Next action: monitor NTA board minutes, NTA and MoCIT notices, the Nepal Gazette, consultation documents and the effective date, and seek official confirmation of the media claim that the draft was returned. Gaps: final licence classes, number of licences, capital requirements, sharing obligations, transition rules and approval timing are unknown.

items.title: 通信部长提出“韧性数字化”五项优先方向，灾害期间服务连续性进入政策核心
items.titleEn: Communications minister sets five priorities for resilient digital transformation
items.text: 事实：尼泊尔公共广播 Radio Nepal、Digital Nepal Conclave 官方议程及 Technology Khabar 显示，通信部长 Dr Bikram Timilsina 于9月20日在拉利特普尔举行的 Digital Nepal Conclave 2026 上表示，数字化不仅是技术扩展和政务现代化，还应在灾害与危机中维持信息、通信及公共服务。他提出五项优先方向：信息可信与公众信任、可靠且包容的连接、政府机构互操作、以公民为中心的数字服务，以及负责任的人工智能与数据治理。此次讲话是政策方向，不是已批准的预算、建设项目、招标或设备授标。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal, the official Digital Nepal Conclave programme and Technology Khabar report that Communications Minister Dr Bikram Timilsina told the 20 September event in Lalitpur that digital transformation must extend beyond technology expansion and service modernisation to maintain information, communications and public services during disasters and crises. He identified five priorities: information integrity and public trust, reliable and inclusive connectivity, interoperability among government bodies, citizen-centred digital services, and responsible AI and data governance. The speech sets policy direction; it is not an approved budget, deployment project, tender or equipment award.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：相关政府机构未来可能把业务连续性、互操作、安全和灾备要求纳入数字战略，但讲话没有确认实施主体、预算或采购范围，因此目前不是可直接计入销售管道的商机。竞争研判：会议信息列出支持方和展示企业，不能据此认定任何公司已获项目、成为投标方或形成设备选型。下一步：跟踪 MoCIT 及相关机构的实施方案、Digital Nepal Framework预算科目、工作组与KPI、PPMO采购公告、政府架构与数据治理标准，以及会后正式记录；只有出现明确责任单位、资金或采购文件后再建立客户机会。证据缺口：时间表、预算、技术架构、采购路径、供应商、合同及历史执行记录均未披露。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: relevant government bodies may incorporate continuity, interoperability, security and recovery requirements into future digital strategies, but the speech confirms no implementation owner, budget or procurement scope. It is therefore not a directly actionable sales opportunity. Competition: the event lists supporters and exhibitors; participation does not establish an award, bidder status or equipment selection. Next action: monitor MoCIT and relevant agencies for implementation plans, Digital Nepal Framework budget lines, working groups and KPIs, PPMO procurement notices, government architecture and data-governance standards, and formal post-event records. Create a customer opportunity only after a responsible agency, funding or procurement document is identified. Gaps: no timetable, budget, architecture, procurement path, supplier, contract or implementation history was disclosed.

items.title: 最高法院驳回四家ISP电信服务税诉状，追缴与罚款风险上升
items.titleEn: Supreme Court dismisses four ISP petitions over telecom service charges
items.text: 事实：Technology Khabar 和 Nagarik Times 9月22日报道，最高法院 Abdul Aziz Musalman 与 Nripadhwaj Niraula 两位法官组成的合议庭，驳回 Dish Media Network、Classic Tech、Vianet Communications 和 Subisu 提交的四份诉状。这些公司分别挑战大额纳税人办公室和税务部门要求缴纳电信服务税（TSC）的决定。Technology Khabar 同时称，法院在 Bhesh Raj Luitel 针对 WorldLink 相关不起诉决定提出的关联诉状中发布了命令。媒体对潜在追缴金额的报道不一致，完整书面判决、逐家公司税额、罚款及适用期间尚未从法院原文核实，因此本简报不采用金额估算。
items.textEn: Technology Khabar and Nagarik Times reported on 22 September that a Supreme Court division bench of Justices Abdul Aziz Musalman and Nripadhwaj Niraula dismissed four petitions filed by Dish Media Network, Classic Tech, Vianet Communications and Subisu. The companies had separately challenged decisions by the Large Taxpayers Office and tax authorities requiring payment of telecom service charges. Technology Khabar also reported that the court issued an order in a related petition by Bhesh Raj Luitel concerning an earlier decision not to prosecute a WorldLink matter. Media estimates of the potential collection differ, and the full written judgment, company-level assessments, penalties and covered tax periods have not been verified from the court text, so this briefing does not adopt an amount estimate.
items.opportunity: 合规影响：四家主要宽带/融合服务商面临更高的历史税款、罚款、现金流和财务披露风险，WorldLink关联案件也需单独核实；这可能影响网络投资节奏、资费、融资和供应商付款，但目前不能量化。竞争研判：裁定不是ICT采购或设备授标，也不能据此判断任何运营商信用事件已经发生。下一步：取得最高法院完整判决和案号，逐一核对税务机关通知、涉及年度、应纳税基数及执行/上诉路径，并跟踪公司公告、NTA与税务部门后续安排。证据缺口：最终应付金额、会计拨备、执行期限、复审可能性及对资本开支的实际影响均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Compliance impact: four major broadband/converged-service providers face higher exposure to historical tax, penalties, cash flow and financial-disclosure risk, while the related WorldLink matter requires separate verification. This could affect network investment timing, tariffs, financing and supplier payments, but cannot yet be quantified. Competition: the ruling is not an ICT procurement or equipment award and does not establish that any operator credit event has occurred. Next action: obtain the full Supreme Court judgments and case numbers, verify each tax notice, covered periods, taxable base and enforcement/appeal path, and monitor company disclosures and follow-up by NTA and tax authorities. Gaps: final payable amount, accounting provisions, enforcement deadline, review options and actual capex impact remain unknown.

items.title: 尼泊尔股市停摆一天后恢复，72家券商系统从灾备中心重启
items.titleEn: Nepal trading resumes after one-day halt as systems for 72 brokers recover from DR site
items.text: 事实：Nepal Stock Exchange（NEPSE）依据交易规则21(1)于9月21日暂停常规交易，原因是托管72家券商服务器的 DataHub Pvt Ltd 数据中心自9月20日上午出现问题。NEPSE 9月22日确认技术问题已解决并恢复常规交易；OnlineKhabar 后续报道称，受影响系统使用 DataHub 位于 Butwal 的灾备中心数据恢复。Kathmandu Post 和 OnlineKhabar 报道，YCO/DataHub 向相关方说明事件涉及勒索软件，并称交易管理系统、CDSC相关系统、支付网关及其他互联服务受到影响。NEPSE 对外公告仍采用“技术问题”表述，因此攻击入口、数据完整性及是否外泄仍须等待正式取证结论。
items.textEn: Nepal Stock Exchange suspended regular trading on 21 September under Rule 21(1) after a problem beginning on the morning of 20 September at DataHub Pvt Ltd, which hosts servers for 72 brokers. NEPSE confirmed on 22 September that the technical problem had been resolved and regular trading resumed; OnlineKhabar subsequently reported that affected systems were restored using data from DataHub's disaster-recovery centre in Butwal. Kathmandu Post and OnlineKhabar report that YCO/DataHub described the incident to stakeholders as ransomware affecting the trading management system, CDSC-related systems, payment gateways and other interconnected services. NEPSE's public notice still uses the term 'technical problem', so the entry vector, data integrity and possible exfiltration require a formal forensic finding.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：NEPSE、券商、DataHub/YCO及证券市场基础设施需要可验证的多站点灾备、不可变备份、网络与身份隔离、安全监测、事件响应和定期演练。系统恢复证明灾备发挥作用，但停市一天也暴露72家券商集中托管与故障域风险；当前仍是恢复与调查，不是公开采购。竞争研判：报道没有披露未来采购主体、预算、招标、技术路线、入围厂商或合同；DataHub 是数据中心、YCO 是交易系统服务商，均不能据此当作设备OEM或中标方。下一步：跟踪 NEPSE、SEBON、CDSC、券商协会及 PPMO 的取证报告、数据完整性验证、补救要求和采购公告，并确认是否形成统一行业韧性标准。证据缺口：攻击入口、数据影响、RPO/RTO、现有架构、预算和采购日程均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and need: NEPSE, brokers, DataHub/YCO and securities-market infrastructure require tested multi-site recovery, immutable backup, network and identity isolation, security monitoring, incident response and regular exercises. Restoration shows that the recovery site functioned, while the one-day halt exposes concentration and shared-failure-domain risk across 72 brokers. The current stage remains recovery and investigation, not a public procurement. Competition: reporting identifies no future buyer, budget, tender, architecture, shortlisted supplier or contract; DataHub is a data centre and YCO a trading-system service provider, so neither can be treated as an equipment OEM or awardee. Next action: follow NEPSE, SEBON, CDSC, the brokers' association and PPMO for forensic reports, data-integrity verification, remediation requirements and procurement notices, and verify whether a common sector-resilience standard emerges. Gaps: entry vector, data impact, RPO/RTO, current architecture, budget and procurement timing are unknown.

items.title: 灾害管理会议推进恢复与安置，救助资料拟逐级核验
items.titleEn: Disaster-management meeting advances recovery and verified relief records
items.badge: Radio Nepal / RSS报道
items.text: Radio Nepal 9月30日刊载RSS报道：内政部长主持的国家减灾与管理机构第37次执行委员会会议决定推进Bhotekoshi灾区搜寻与恢复、临时住房及重建安置，搜寻工作仍在继续。报道还称，失踪人员家庭的救助资料拟由地方政府核实，经地区行政办公室复核后报送灾害管理机构。这里只记录所报道的会议安排；没有据此认定相关法律已修改，也未核验实施细则或采购文件。
items.textEn: A 30 September Radio Nepal/RSS report says the disaster-management authority's 37th executive committee meeting, chaired by the home minister, advanced Bhotekoshi search and recovery, temporary housing and rehabilitation while searches continued. It describes relief records for families of missing people being verified by local governments, rechecked by district administration offices and forwarded to the authority. This records reported meeting arrangements, not a confirmed legal amendment; implementation rules and procurement documents were not verified.
items.opportunity: 研判：此项首先是救助与行政协同，不是ICT销售线索。逐级核验可能带来安全交换、去重与审计留痕需求，但没有已核验的数字平台招标。下一步取得正式决议及执行通知，确认责任部门、数据最小化、访问权限与资金安排；不得推定救助到账时间或法定资格已改变。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: This is primarily relief administration, not an ICT sales lead. Tiered verification could require secure exchange, deduplication and audit trails, but no digital-platform tender is verified. Obtain the formal decision and implementation notice, then identify responsible offices, data minimisation, access controls and funding. Do not infer payment timing or changed legal eligibility.

items.title: 内阁批准公务员法案提交议会，任命能源部秘书
items.titleEn: Cabinet endorses civil-service bill submission and names energy secretary
items.text: NepalKhabar 9月29日转述政府发言人公布的六项内阁决定：批准将联邦公务员法案提交议会；将 Jagdishwar Karmacharya 晋升并任命为能源、水资源与灌溉部秘书，同时任命 Aabha Shrestha Karna 为甘达基省首席秘书。本条依据媒体发布的决议清单，尚待官方任命文件补核；法案获准提交不等于已获议会通过或生效。
items.textEn: NepalKhabar's 29 September account of six Cabinet decisions, attributed to the government spokesperson, includes approval to submit the federal civil-service bill and the promotion and appointment of Jagdishwar Karmacharya as energy, water resources and irrigation secretary, and Aabha Shrestha Karna as Gandaki chief secretary. Official appointment documents remain to be cross-checked. Submission approval is not parliamentary passage or commencement.
items.opportunity: 研判：能源项目的行政协调联系人可能随任命调整，应先核对正式履职与职责分工；不据人事变动推断NEA招标偏好或采购结果。 下一步：以政府公报或内阁秘书处正式文件确认任命，再更新人员监控矩阵。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: verify formal assumption of office and responsibilities before updating energy-project engagement contacts. Personnel changes do not establish NEA tender preferences or procurement outcomes. Next check: confirm appointments in official Cabinet Secretariat or gazette documents before changing the personnel matrix.

items.title: 国防大学法案进入审议，网络安全纳入拟议研究方向
items.titleEn: Defence university bill considered; cybersecurity included in proposed remit
items.text: Radio Nepal/RSS 报道，9月29日众议院通过了审议《国防大学法案》的动议。司法部长解释，拟建机构面向国家安全、外交与网络安全等学术研究，而非单纯军队训练学校。当前是法案审议进展，不是法律最终生效，也未证实校园、实验室或ICT采购已获批。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal/RSS reports that the House approved a motion to consider the defence university bill on 29 September. The law minister described an academic remit including national security, diplomacy and cybersecurity, rather than military training alone. Consideration is not final enactment; no campus, laboratory or ICT procurement approval is established.
items.opportunity: 研判：先跟踪法案文本、办学主体和拨款。网络安全研究方向可能带来教学平台需求，但尚不足以判断建设规模、采购时间或供应商。 触发条件：法案后续通过、生效、筹备机构及拨款须逐项核对，不能把拟议研究方向当成已批准实验室项目。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: track the bill, institutional ownership and appropriations first. Cybersecurity studies could require teaching platforms, but scale, procurement timing and suppliers are not established. Trigger: check passage, commencement, a preparatory body and appropriations separately; a proposed research subject is not an approved laboratory project.

items.title: 印度驻尼大使向总理辞行，继任安排尚待官方确认
items.titleEn: Indian ambassador makes farewell call; successor arrangements remain unconfirmed
items.badge: 双源报道 · ANI引述总理办公室
items.text: OnlineKhabar及ANI于9月29日报道，印度驻尼大使Naveen Srivastava在任期结束前拜会总理Balendra Shah。ANI引述尼泊尔总理办公室声明称，双方回顾发展合作，尼方感谢印度对近期灾害的援助。此为辞行会面，不是新大使任命或递交国书；本轮未取得继任者任命及到任的官方文件。
items.textEn: OnlineKhabar and ANI reported on 29 September that Indian Ambassador Naveen Srivastava made a farewell call on Prime Minister Balendra Shah before completing his tenure. ANI cited Nepal's PMO on development cooperation and Nepal's thanks for India's disaster assistance. This is a farewell meeting, not the appointment or credential presentation of a successor; no official successor appointment or arrival record was obtained in this review.
items.opportunity: 研判：涉及外交联络窗口交接，不自动意味着项目政策或执行暂停。下一步核对印度外交部及使馆的继任公告、到任及递交国书安排，确认临时代办和项目联络人；跨境能源与基础设施合作仍按各自批复、合同和实际进度判断。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: This concerns diplomatic handover, not evidence of policy change or project suspension. Check India's foreign ministry and embassy for successor appointment, arrival and credential presentation, and confirm interim and project contacts. Assess cross-border energy and infrastructure cooperation against its own approvals, contracts and actual progress.

items.title: 中尼陆路口岸运输受阻，设备交付需逐单核对物流风险
items.titleEn: China–Nepal land-route disruptions warrant shipment-level delivery checks
items.text: New Business Age 9月30日报道，多个对华陆路通道受阻，节前货物滞留；尼中人员已检查Tatopani口岸条件。报道主要涉及消费品和商贸物流，没有证明某个通信厂家的设备被扣留或某个ICT项目延期，也不能据此宣布口岸已经恢复通关。
items.textEn: New Business Age reports on 30 September that disrupted China-facing land routes are delaying pre-festival cargo, while a Nepal–China team inspected Tatopani. The report concerns trade logistics, not evidence that a named telecom supplier's equipment is stranded or an ICT project delayed. Inspection does not establish reopening.
items.opportunity: 研判：对计划从中国陆运的设备，逐单核对路线、在途状态、备货和验收节点，再比较替代运输的时间及成本；不要套用消费品报道中的运价作为通信设备报价。 下一步：以海关及口岸办公室的通关状态核对承运商到货承诺；不同口岸及货类不能直接类推。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: for equipment planned overland from China, verify routes, shipment status, spares and acceptance dates before comparing alternatives. Consumer-goods freight quotations are not telecom-equipment quotations. Next check: compare carrier delivery promises with customs and border-office operating notices; do not generalise across crossings or cargo classes.

items.title: 总理提出尼中印气候韧性机制，明确卫星数据共享和联合预警方向
items.titleEn: Nepal proposes trilateral climate-resilience mechanism with satellite-data sharing and joint warnings
items.text: 官方原文：外交部公布的9月24日联大讲话确认，总理提出由尼泊尔、印度和中国推动喜马拉雅气候韧性机制，涵盖卫星数据与专业知识共享、危险冰湖监测、联合预警和跨境救援协调。Radio Nepal 9月28日报道部长在27日研讨会上呼应该方向，本简报合并为同一政策线索，不重复计数。机制尚为尼方提议，未见三方签署、预算或采购文件。
items.textEn: Primary source: the Foreign Ministry's text of the prime minister's 24 September UN address proposes a Nepal–India–China Himalayan climate-resilience mechanism for satellite-data and expertise sharing, dangerous-lake monitoring, joint warnings and coordinated cross-border assistance. Radio Nepal's 28 September report describes ministerial support at a 27 September seminar; this is treated as the same policy thread, not a second event. It remains a Nepal proposal, without an identified trilateral agreement, budget or procurement.
items.opportunity: 研判：有明确的数据互通和预警系统方向，但不是招标。后续核实牵头机构、跨境数据规则、资金与试点范围；在获得正式需求后再讨论监测接入、数据平台及通信备份方案。与既有MAZU平台新闻是不同事件，不能假定该平台已获三国机制采用；无已确认厂家。 下一步以三方工作方案和实施时间表为观察点，而不是把研讨会表态当成新项目。
items.opportunityEn: Assessment: data interoperability and warning systems are explicit directions, not a tender. Verify the lead agency, cross-border data rules, funding and pilot scope before proposing monitoring access, platforms or backup communications. This is distinct from the existing MAZU transfer story; adoption of that platform by the proposed mechanism is not established. No vendor is confirmed. Watch for a trilateral work plan and implementation timetable rather than treating seminar statements as a new project.

items.titleEn: Nepal–UAE ministerial meeting: USD 25 million remains a pledge
items.text: 原文复核：Kathmandu Post 9月27日报道会谈于纽约当地周六（9月26日）举行，Radio Nepal 于9月28日跟进。报道指尼泊尔外长感谢阿联酋新增2500万美元灾后援助承诺，并讨论投资、可再生能源与互联互通。这里核对的是公开报道，不是资金到账；尚未取得拨付凭证或项目清单。
items.textEn: Source review: The Kathmandu Post's 27 September article dates the New York meeting to Saturday, 26 September; Radio Nepal followed on 28 September. Reports describe thanks for an additional USD 25 million UAE flood-aid pledge and discussion of investment, renewable energy and connectivity. This verifies the reporting, not disbursement; no payment record or project list was obtained.
items.opportunity: 研判：属外交与援助意向，不列为已落地ICT商机。关注财政部、外交部后续公布的执行单位、用途和拨付安排；在出现具体数字基础设施项目及采购公告前，不推断合同金额或设备厂家。 同时核对阿联酋官方协议或拨付公告，不以尼方感谢表态替代出资方执行证据。
items.opportunityEn: Assessment: diplomatic and aid intentions, not an established ICT opportunity. Check finance and foreign-affairs releases for implementing entities, allocation and disbursement; do not infer a contract value or OEM before a defined digital project and procurement notice exist. Also check UAE agreements or disbursement notices; Nepal's expression of thanks does not substitute for execution evidence from the donor.

items.title: 中国向尼泊尔移交 MAZU 人工智能气象平台，后续拟部署卫星AI设备
items.titleEn: China transfers MAZU AI weather platform to Nepal and outlines satellite-AI follow-on
items.text: 事实：Annapurna Express、Technology Khabar、Bizmandu 和 Baahrakhari 9月22日报道，中国气象局在乌鲁木齐举行的第二届中国—中亚气象合作论坛期间，将 MAZU-NEPAL 人工智能气象平台正式移交尼泊尔水文与气象部门。平台自8月29日起开展云端试运行，整合风云气象卫星观测与“风清”“风顺”等中国AI预报模型，为尼泊尔提供高分辨率快速监测和预警；报道还称双方计划在尼泊尔部署 MAZU-风云卫星AI Box及集成设备，并建立技术培训、数据共享和联合会商机制。现有报道未披露采购合同、预算、软硬件清单、本地部署位置或数据治理条款。
items.textEn: Annapurna Express, Technology Khabar, Bizmandu and Baahrakhari reported on 22 September that China Meteorological Administration formally transferred the MAZU-NEPAL AI meteorological platform to Nepal's hydrology and meteorology authority during the second China-Central Asia Meteorological Cooperation Forum in Urumqi. Cloud trial operation began on 29 August. The platform integrates FengYun satellite observations with Chinese AI forecasting models including Fengqing and Fengshun to provide high-resolution rapid monitoring and warnings customised for Nepal. Reporting also says the parties plan to deploy a MAZU-FengYun Satellite AI Box and integrated equipment in Nepal and establish technical training, data sharing and joint consultation mechanisms. No procurement contract, budget, bill of materials, local hosting site or data-governance terms have been disclosed.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：尼泊尔水文与气象部门、灾害管理机构及地方预警体系可能需要卫星数据接入、边缘AI设备、算力与存储、网络连接、集成、培训和长期运维。当前阶段是政府间技术移交和后续合作意向，不是公开招标或商业授标。竞争研判：平台和计划中的AI Box来自中国气象局体系，不能推定华为、运营商或本地集成商已参与，也不能把未来设备计划视为已签合同。下一步：核查中国气象局和尼泊尔官方移交文件、DHM/NDRRMA实施计划、设备部署时间、数据跨境与主权要求、运维责任、资金来源及任何 PPMO 采购。证据缺口：预算、采购方式、设备配置、接口、本地托管、安全基线、供应商和服务期限均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and need: Nepal's hydrology and meteorology authority, disaster-management agencies and local warning systems may require satellite-data access, edge-AI equipment, compute and storage, connectivity, integration, training and long-term operations. The present stage is an intergovernmental technology transfer and follow-on cooperation intent, not an open tender or commercial award. Competition: the platform and planned AI Box come through the China Meteorological Administration system; this does not establish participation by Huawei, an operator or a local integrator, nor does the future equipment plan constitute a signed contract. Next action: obtain CMA and Nepal government transfer records, DHM/NDRRMA implementation plans, deployment timing, cross-border and sovereign-data requirements, operations ownership, funding source and any PPMO procurement. Gaps: budget, procurement method, equipment configuration, interfaces, local hosting, security baseline, supplier and service term remain unknown.

items.title: Nepal Telecom 发布宪法日套餐：大流量促销仍设每日高速限额
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom announces Constitution Day plans with daily high-speed limits
items.text: 事实：运营商9月17日（尼历2083年6月1日）公告面向预付费与后付费客户推出两款30天套餐：含税499尼泊尔卢比，每日5GB后限速2Mbps；含税699尼泊尔卢比，每日10GB后限速3Mbps。办理窗口为9月18—20日。已核对官方扫描公告；“无限”不等于全程不限速，也不是网络扩容或设备采购公告。
items.textEn: The operator's 17 September release announces two 30-day plans: NPR 499 including tax for 5 GB/day, then 2 Mbps; NPR 699 for 10 GB/day, then 3 Mbps. Subscription is available 18–20 September for prepaid and postpaid customers. The scanned official release was checked. Unlimited usage does not mean unlimited high-speed data, and the offer does not establish a network expansion or equipment purchase.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：Nepal Telecom 的限时套餐将竞争焦点放在日流量额度与达量后体验，不能据此推定扩容。竞争研判：本条未披露其他运营商响应或设备供应商。下一步：向客户市场与网络团队核查套餐办理量、忙时负载、限速投诉及策略计费要求，再判断是否存在优化需求；整体用户或收入变化不能单独证明本次活动效果。证据缺口：增量流量、预算和采购计划未披露。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: Nepal Telecom's limited-time plans focus attention on daily allowances and post-cap experience; they do not establish capacity expansion. Competition: no rival response or equipment supplier is disclosed in this item. Next action: check take-up, busy-hour load, throttling complaints and policy/charging requirements with the marketing and network teams before assessing optimisation needs. Aggregate subscriber or revenue changes alone cannot establish the campaign's effect. Evidence gaps: incremental traffic, budget and procurement plans are undisclosed.

items.title: Ncell 引入 Eutelsat 低轨卫星，为洪灾地区恢复连接
items.titleEn: Ncell deploys Eutelsat LEO connectivity for flood relief
items.text: 事实：Ncell 公告称，已在 Nuwakot 三处关键地点部署卫星接入设备，并与救灾机构协调扩展；设备通过本地 Wi-Fi 提供连接，而非手机直接连接卫星。公司称已取得 NTA 等部门批准。ICT Frame 9月8日报道与公告一致。该部署是应急补充网络，不能等同于全国卫星业务开放或 5G 商用。
items.textEn: Ncell says satellite terminals are operating at three critical locations in Nuwakot, with expansion coordinated with relief agencies. Local Wi-Fi distributes the connection; this is not direct-to-handset satellite service. The company reports obtaining regulatory approvals. ICT Frame reported the deployment on 8 September. Emergency use does not establish nationwide commercial authorization or a 5G launch.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：Ncell 的救灾部署提示偏远及受灾站点对备用回传和现场 Wi-Fi 的需求，但商业化适用范围尚待核实。竞争研判：Eutelsat 合作属于应急连接方案，不能外推为全国地面网络替换或其他厂家失单。下一步：核查监管批准原文、灾后是否保留链路，以及带宽、时延、供电与维护条件，再比较卫星和地面备用方案的成本及适用场景。证据缺口：设备型号、采购金额与长期服务条款未披露。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: Ncell's relief deployment points to backup backhaul and local Wi-Fi needs at remote or affected sites, but the scope for commercial use remains unverified. Competition: the Eutelsat cooperation is an emergency connectivity solution, not evidence of nationwide terrestrial replacement or another vendor losing a contract. Next action: check the original regulatory approval, post-disaster retention, bandwidth, latency, power and maintenance requirements before comparing satellite and terrestrial backup costs and use cases. Gaps: device models, purchase value and long-term service terms are undisclosed.

items.title: Nepal Telecom 提醒出境前开通 VoLTE，关注漫游互通质量
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom reminds travellers to enable VoLTE
items.text: 事实：9月15日行业报道转述 Nepal Telecom 的出境漫游提醒：在部分已关闭 2G/3G 的目的地，用户需提前开通 VoLTE。运营商官方漫游资费页列出支持网络并说明 4G SIM、VoLTE 开通和终端设置要求。本条是使用提醒，不是本期新建 VoLTE 网络，也不意味着所有国家均支持。
items.textEn: A 15 September report relays Nepal Telecom's reminder to activate VoLTE before travelling to destinations where legacy networks have closed. The operator's roaming page confirms supported networks and SIM/device requirements. This is a service advisory, not a new network launch or universal roaming availability.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：对前往已关闭旧制式网络地区的 Nepal Telecom 用户，漫游体验取决于终端、SIM、业务开通与境外合作网络兼容性。竞争研判：应比较经核实的目的地覆盖与通话体验，不能把使用提醒写成新增 IMS 或核心网订单。下一步：由漫游与客服团队逐项确认境外合作运营商支持清单、终端要求和失败案例；境外退网信息应核查当地运营商或监管机构，而非尼泊尔 NTA。证据缺口：受影响用户规模、互通改造与采购计划未披露。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: for Nepal Telecom travellers to markets where legacy networks have closed, roaming depends on device, SIM, service activation and overseas partner compatibility. Competition: compare verified destination coverage and call experience; a usage advisory is not a new IMS or core-network order. Next action: have roaming and support teams check overseas partner support, handset requirements and failed-call cases. Verify foreign network shutdowns with the relevant overseas operator or regulator, not Nepal's NTA. Gaps: affected-user scale, interworking upgrades and procurement plans are undisclosed.

items.title: NTA 公布 800MHz 剩余频谱竞价说明会安排
items.titleEn: NTA schedules an 800 MHz spectrum pre-bid conference
items.text: 事实：NTA 公告安排在尼历2083年Ashoj月2日（9月18日）16:30举行 800MHz 剩余频谱竞价的投标前会议。公告追溯8月25日发布的竞价申请文件。本期新增信息是会议安排，不是频谱已授予、更不是设备采购结果。会议是否按时举行及答疑纪要，仍需后续核实。
items.textEn: NTA announced a pre-bid conference for residual 800 MHz spectrum on 18 September at 16:30 Nepal time, referencing the application documents issued on 25 August. The new development is the meeting notice, not a spectrum award or equipment contract. Actual proceedings and clarifications still require follow-up verification.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：800MHz 投标前会议通知是频谱流程信号，尚不能计入设备采购商机。竞争研判：未见本条材料披露投标名单或授标结果，不推定任何运营商或厂家获益。下一步：先确认会议是否举行及答疑文件，再核查频段配置、使用条件、投标期限和后续授标；只有取得运营商建设计划，才能讨论现网兼容、站点及射频设备需求。证据缺口：成交价格、部署技术、覆盖承诺和设备预算仍待核实。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: the 800 MHz pre-bid notice signals progress in a spectrum process, not an equipment opportunity ready for the pipeline. Competition: the supplied material contains no bidder list or award result; no operator or vendor benefit is assumed. Next action: confirm the meeting and clarifications, then check band configuration, usage conditions, deadlines and subsequent awards. Discuss network compatibility, sites and radio equipment only when operator deployment plans are available. Gaps: award price, deployment technology, coverage obligations and equipment budgets remain unverified.

items.title: NTA 发布 UTL 牌照自动取消通知，交易前需核查资产权属
items.titleEn: NTA publishes UTL licence-cancellation notice
items.text: 事实：NTA 本期公告目录以尼历Bhadra26日（9月11日）列出 UTL 牌照自动取消通知；后续尼语与英文报道讨论基础设施移交。9月4日续期截止属于前期背景，不冒充本期新事件。不同媒体对欠款口径及公告进度表述不一致，本简报不合并成一个确定金额，也不将报道等同于最终资产处置结果。
items.textEn: NTA's notice index dates the UTL automatic licence-cancellation notice to 11 September. Subsequent Nepali and English coverage discusses infrastructure handover. The 4 September renewal deadline is prior-period context. Reports differ on liabilities and procedural timing, so no consolidated debt figure or final asset-disposal outcome is asserted.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：如客户或合作伙伴存在 UTL 相关合同、应收款或设施依赖，需逐项核实服务与交易风险，不能仅凭牌照新闻推断实际用户受损。竞争研判：资产或用户转移尚无本条可核实的承接安排，不列作竞争对手份额变化。下一步：取得 NTA 通知及后续处置文件，分别核对设施权属、频谱使用权、合同迁移条件与争议状态；不把频谱当作可自由转让的普通资产。证据缺口：媒体欠款口径不同，最终处置、承接方及责任分配未确认。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: where customers or partners have UTL-related contracts, receivables or facility dependencies, assess service and transaction exposure case by case; licence news alone does not prove actual subscriber harm. Competition: no verified recipient arrangement for assets or users is established here, so do not record a market-share transfer. Next action: obtain NTA's notice and disposal documents; separately verify facility title, spectrum usage rights, contract-transfer conditions and disputes. Do not treat spectrum as an ordinary freely transferable asset. Gaps: liability figures differ across reports; final disposal, recipients and allocation of responsibilities remain unconfirmed.

items.title: 国家要闻：内阁推荐13国大使人选，并通过相关政策决定
items.titleEn: National affairs: Cabinet proposes envoys to 13 countries and endorses policy decisions
items.text: 据公共广播 Radio Nepal 引述政府发言人及《加德满都邮报》报道，9月18日内阁推荐13国大使人选：驻华 Kalyan Raj Sharma、驻印 Nischal Nath Pandey、驻美 Chiran Jung Thapa。推荐不等于正式任命，仍需跟进议会听证、驻在国同意及总统任命。同次会议据报道通过公民身份条例第五次修订及政府职责分工调整，包括水文气象部门转归能源部；条例正文与生效日期尚待核对，不据报道推定已经生效。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal, citing the government spokesperson, and The Kathmandu Post report that the Cabinet recommended envoys to 13 countries on 18 September, including Kalyan Raj Sharma for China, Nischal Nath Pandey for India and Chiran Jung Thapa for the US. These are nominations, not completed appointments; hearings, receiving-state consent and presidential appointments require follow-up. Radio Nepal also reports approval of a fifth amendment to citizenship regulations and a work-allocation change moving hydrology and meteorology to the Energy Ministry. The legal text and effective dates remain unverified.
items.opportunity: 影响研判：大使提名属于外交人事进程，不能据此判断对华、对印或对美政策已转向，更不直接对应厂家订单。职责分工调整若正式生效，可能改变相关机构的管理和预算对接路径，但这是条件性判断。下一步：跟踪听证、驻在国同意及正式任命；核对政府公报中的职责分工文本和生效日期，再确认项目审批或采购主体是否变化。证据缺口：提名后的程序进展、正式法规文本及任何新增 ICT 预算尚待核实。
items.opportunityEn: Implications: ambassador nominations are a diplomatic personnel process, not proof of a policy shift toward China, India or the US, and not vendor orders. If the work-allocation changes formally take effect, administrative and budget interfaces may change; this is a conditional assessment. Next action: follow hearings, receiving-state consent and formal appointments; check Gazette texts and effective dates before confirming any change in project approval or procurement authority. Gaps: subsequent nomination steps, formal legal texts and any additional ICT budget remain to be verified.

items.title: WorldLink 推出 Biz24：从带宽销售延伸到企业托管 Wi-Fi
items.titleEn: WorldLink introduces Biz24 managed Wi-Fi for SMEs
items.text: 事实：WorldLink 官方页面展示 Biz24 企业托管 Wi-Fi；ICT Frame 9月10日报道其面向中小企业，提供按场地规划的无线覆盖、云端管理及优先支持。这里的“首个”属于企业营销表述，不作独立市场排名。产品发布不代表已公布新的设备采购合同。
items.textEn: WorldLink's official site presents Biz24, with a 10 September report describing premises-specific Wi-Fi coverage, cloud management and priority support for SMEs. 'First' is a company marketing claim, not an independently verified ranking. A service launch does not establish a new equipment procurement contract.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：WorldLink 的价值主张由接入带宽延伸至场地无线覆盖、云管理与服务支持，潜在采购评估应关注持续运维能力。竞争研判：与本期 Classic Tech 中小企业套餐存在目标客户重叠，但不代表两者功能或 SLA 相同，也未确认设备厂家。下一步：向企业业务团队核查覆盖设计、SLA、平台管理权、CPE 归属和维护责任，再提出设备与托管服务方案。证据缺口：本条材料不足以确认定价、客户规模、厂家选型及新增招标。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: WorldLink's proposition extends beyond access bandwidth to premises coverage, cloud management and support, making ongoing operations relevant to potential procurement assessments. Competition: target customers overlap with this issue's Classic Tech SME package, but functionality and SLAs are not necessarily equivalent; no equipment OEM is confirmed. Next action: check coverage design, SLAs, platform control, CPE ownership and maintenance responsibilities with the enterprise team before proposing equipment or managed-service options. Gaps: the supplied material does not establish pricing, customer scale, vendor selection or a new tender.

items.title: Classic Tech 发布 SME Pro Max，企业千兆接入竞争升温
items.titleEn: Classic Tech launches SME Pro Max business broadband
items.text: 事实：NepaliTelecom 9月16日及尼语媒体报道 Classic Tech 的 SME Pro Max：面向中小企业与初创公司，组合千兆带宽、Wi-Fi 6 路由器及安装支持；符合条件的初创企业可享折扣。报道提到流量额度，不能将“1Gbps”解读为无条件无限量或独享带宽。套餐条款须以运营商合同确认。
items.textEn: English and Nepali reports describe Classic Tech's SME Pro Max offer for small businesses and startups, bundling gigabit access, a Wi-Fi 6 router and installation support, with eligibility-based discounts. Reported allowances mean headline speed must not be read as unlimited dedicated bandwidth. Contract terms require operator confirmation.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：Classic Tech 的千兆接入与 Wi-Fi 6 套餐把接入、终端和服务条款组合销售，评估不能只比较标称速率。竞争研判：与 WorldLink Biz24 的中小企业客群可能重叠，但托管深度及服务保障须同口径核查；Wi-Fi 6 不等于已确定某家设备厂商。下一步：取得书面条款，比较共享或独享带宽、上下行速率、流量额度、超量处理、CPE 产权与折扣资格，再判断供应合作空间。证据缺口：完整合同、实际性能及设备采购规模尚未在本次材料中核实。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: Classic Tech combines gigabit access, Wi-Fi 6 equipment and service terms; evaluation should go beyond headline speed. Competition: SME customers may overlap with WorldLink Biz24, but management scope and service guarantees require like-for-like checks. Wi-Fi 6 does not identify an OEM. Next action: obtain written terms covering shared versus dedicated access, upstream/downstream rates, allowances, overage treatment, CPE ownership and discount eligibility before assessing supplier opportunities. Gaps: full contracts, measured performance and equipment procurement scale have not been verified in this review.

items.title: Vianet 成为 PMGO 尼泊尔赛事网络伙伴
items.titleEn: Vianet becomes internet partner for PMGO in Nepal
items.text: 事实：Vianet 官方 LinkedIn 动态及9月15日 ShareSansar 报道确认其为 PUBG MOBILE Global Open 提供赛事连接，强调稳定性和低时延。合作已宣布，但公告没有给出带宽、网络设备型号、合同金额或性能实测结果；不将宣传中的可靠性描述作为独立测评。
items.textEn: Vianet's LinkedIn update and ShareSansar's 15 September report confirm an internet partnership for PUBG MOBILE Global Open in Nepal. Stability and low latency are emphasized, but bandwidth, equipment, contract value and measured performance are not disclosed. Promotional reliability claims are not independent benchmarks.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：赛事合作为 Vianet 提供展示网络服务能力的场景，但宣传中的低时延与稳定性不等于第三方测试结论。竞争研判：本条未确认其他 ISP 的对应动作，也不能据赞助关系推定设备扩容。下一步：向赛事或网络运维团队核查实际带宽、并发量、时延和丢包记录，以及是否存在备用链路或临时保障需求；据此判断可复制的场馆服务方案。证据缺口：合同金额、厂家、网络规模与实测数据未披露。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: the event partnership gives Vianet a setting to demonstrate service capability, but promotional latency and reliability claims are not independent test results. Competition: this item establishes no matching action by other ISPs, and sponsorship does not prove equipment expansion. Next action: check actual bandwidth, concurrent usage, latency and loss records with event or network operations teams, including backup links or temporary support requirements, before assessing repeatable venue-service offerings. Gaps: contract value, OEM, network scale and measurements are undisclosed.

items.title: 数字议会平台开放测试，公共部门数字化进入应用验证
items.titleEn: Digital Parliament opens for public testing
items.text: 事实：9月16日尼泊尔公共广播及行业媒体报道数字议会平台进入公开测试；官方门户可查询议员、委员会与会议。测试阶段允许公众反馈，不能把平台试运行理解为整体政府云项目验收或新增采购。不同报道对早期立项年份有差异，本条只确认本期公开测试与当前门户功能。
items.textEn: Nepal's public broadcaster and industry media reported the Digital Parliament public trial on 16 September. The official portal exposes members, committees and meeting information. Public testing does not constitute acceptance of a government-wide cloud project or a new tender. Conflicting accounts of the original project year are not repeated.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：数字议会公开测试使平台可用性、数据更新与用户反馈成为后续观察重点；可进一步核查运维、安全及灾备要求，但尚非已确认采购需求。竞争研判：本次材料没有确证开发、托管或设备供应商，不将试运行记为任何厂家中标。下一步：核查议会秘书处公布的测试范围、维护主体、预算与采购公告，再判断后续服务参与方式。证据缺口：合同金额、厂家、运维安排和新增招标未在本次核验中建立；不以门户上线反推整体政府云验收。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: public testing makes platform availability, data updates and user feedback relevant follow-up areas. Operations, security and recovery requirements warrant checking, but are not confirmed procurement needs. Competition: this review establishes no developer, hosting provider or equipment supplier; the trial is not a vendor award. Next action: check the Parliament Secretariat's trial scope, maintenance owner, budget and procurement notices before assessing any role for suppliers. Gaps: contract value, vendors, operating arrangements and new tenders are not established by this review; portal availability does not prove government-wide cloud acceptance.
